# D5 U4.7 entry-point inventory

The JSON is the single source of inventory data at base `687e68de`.
This artifact proposes dispositions; it does not establish containment.

86 conservative roots (31 seeds and 55 additions), 103 grouped mode records,
17 manifest boundaries, 76 historical route IDs, and 6 tool parsers.
Effects are conservative unions within groups. A selected mode need not reach
every effect in its group. Parser selectors include delegated definitions.

- **F1** — unit allocate/bind/check and remote --worker/--supervise have no D5 guard; standalone writes/judgments/launches remain reachable. OD1 mandates unit refusal; propose remote refusal. Records: `r62.0`, `r55.0`, `r63.1`.
- **F2** — linear_sync mutators lack entry refusal. Existing project->swarm dependency is already declared; resolve d5_activation through sibling_skill_root, fail closed. audit/section admitted, but unsafe --out and API query/mutation separation need tests. Records: `r38.0`, `r38.1`, `r37.1`.
- **F3** — Review and committee intrinsically use provider/gate-local effects; HANIG_COMMITTEE_DIR and state-root overrides can alias protected destinations. Gate-local confinement, child journal and cold-import bytecode require root-specific proof, not blanket b14 ban. Records: `r43.0`, `r47.0`.
- **F4** — Cron redirection precedes swarm active refusal; direct contract/handoff/installer/test/verifier entry points and imported helpers are additional effects. None inherit a containing-root guard. Records: `r56.0`, `r65.0`, `r34.0`, `r09.0`, `r74.0`, `r75.0`, `r76.0`, `r77.0`, `r78.0`, `r79.0`, `r80.0`, `r81.0`, `r82.0`, `r83.0`, `r84.0`, `r85.0`.
- **F5** — Immutable vendored workflows and patched bus have daemon, subprocess and state effects without D5 guards. Proposed refusal needs assembled-profile ownership or a ruling outside these immutable bundles. Records: `r03.0`, `r11.0`, `r66.0`, `r67.0`, `r68.0`, `r69.0`, `r70.0`, `r71.0`, `r72.0`.
- **F6** — Direct d5 worker_spawn and synthetic boundary callbacks can launch arbitrary code; empty protected bootstrap set covers only protected_spawn. Proposed refusal of process/bootstrap APIs, purpose-bound admission of installation/merge helpers needs proof. Records: `r18.0`, `r25.0`, `r29.0`.
- **F7** — Manifest is a historical classification: b7/b8 reachable inactive but bypassed by active merge return; audit query POST is not b9 mutation; review b14 explicitly admitted. No production containment conclusion follows from this inventory. Records: `r31.0`, `r31.2`, `r38.0`, `r47.0`.
- **F8** — probe.sh performs external curl HEAD requests; model_family exposes snapshot writes. Neither route is covered by a containing-root D5 guard. Propose refusal before effects. Records: `r06.0`, `r44.1`.

- **F9** — Additional auxiliary roots and direct helper APIs need profile coverage: unguarded writes/launches, admitted output destinations and installation-only access. Existing downstream refusals still need root-specific proof. ## Proposed partition

Each implementation unit is capped at 55,000 diff bytes. Proof remains with
its effect owner; integrated discovery does not substitute for behavioral proof.

- P1: direct unit, verifier and contract roots; b15–b20, direct CLI mutations.
- P2: tracker mutation refusal and query-only audit/section; b9, routes 75–76.
- P3: admitted review/committee provider and local-state effects; b14.
- P4: auxiliary binaries, shells, packaging and immutable vendored workflows.
- P5: helper APIs, admitted merge and observations; b0–b8, routes 1–74.
- P6: repository-wide reconciliation after P1–P5 integrate. Reject missing or
  unresolved final dispositions; invalidate evidence on relevant code, parser,
  launcher or packaging changes. U4.7 acceptance requires that final coverage.

## Reading the JSON

`root_columns` and `record_columns` name each array column. `S/O/P/G` expand
through `source_roots`; citation paths can also use a root ID. Citation line
numbers refer to this base. `$tN` branch text expands through `text`.

`roots` contains discovery sources, parser selectors, environment **names** and
API names. `records` links each mode group to effects, one proposed disposition,
guard ordering, proof and placement. `refused` means **refused before first
effect** is proposed; `guards` says whether that refusal currently exists.
`new: true` explicitly identifies records absent from the older manifest/routes.

`parsers`, `boundaries` and `routes` reconcile in both directions with record IDs;
route site lines retain their historical inventory provenance, not current line
numbers. `selector_records` owns all recovered selectors for each root group.
`finding_records` locates unaccounted effects. `admitted_reachability` identifies
proposed owning roots and potential helper paths; it is not execution evidence.

`probe_evidence` names uncommitted scripts and verbatim outputs in the attempt
artifact directory. Interception or invalid fixture preconditions leave downstream
proof outstanding. No observation here grants a D5 permit. OD1 explicitly admits
review/committee provider POSTs and gate-local state; U4.9 must carry that
admission into the assembled profile. U4.1, U6, OD5 and the empty bootstrap set stay.
